sections.h2: Why does Jasper County, Georgia feel so rural?
sections.html:
Jasper County has no large city. Monticello is the lone city and the seat, Shady Dale is the lone town, and the 2020 census recorded the entire population as rural, with a median age of 41.7. The county covers 373 square miles, of which about 5 are water.

It dates to December 10, 1807, carved out of Baldwin County and first called Randolph, then renamed for Sergeant William Jasper in 1812, per Wikipedia. Newton County was later cut from part of it, in 1821.

Morgan, Putnam, Jones, Monroe, Butts and Newton counties ring it. Pieces of the Oconee National Forest and the Piedmont National Wildlife Refuge sit inside the line, so a good share of the county's land is public. Runoff west of State Route 11 reaches the Upper Ocmulgee; the eastern side feeds the Upper Oconee. Four schools make up the county school system, and the high school is Jasper County High School.

sections.h2: What do Jasper County's housing numbers look like?
sections.html:
Jasper County is small but climbing fast. The Census Bureau's July 2025 estimate is 17,632 people, 20.8% above its April 2020 base, after only 4.9% growth between the 2010 and 2020 counts.

Population stood at 5,760 in 1970. The drive to work averages almost 40 minutes, and Wikipedia places the county in the Atlanta-Sandy Springs-Roswell metro area. The 2020 census listed 6,270 housing units with 13.7% vacant, and density was 39.6 residents per square mile. On acreage, buyers tend to ask about wells, septic systems and road frontage.

sections.h2: Who lives in Jasper County, and what do they pay to get around?
sections.html:
Jasper County has 5,965 households averaging 2.65 people, and 91.8% of residents were in the same home a year before, a steadier base than most growing counties. About 22.6% of residents are under 18 and 19.2% are 65 or older.

Nearly nine in ten adults, 89.6%, have a high school diploma, and 19.5% have a bachelor's degree or more. Median owner costs run $1,461 a month with a mortgage and $480 without one. The county had 225 employer establishments in 2023, employing 1,911 people, which explains the long commutes. Poverty affects 13.2% of residents.

For a seller, those owner-cost figures set a ceiling on what many local buyers can carry. A house priced near the $243,400 middle value will draw more buyers than one far above it.

sections.h2: Who does what on a Jasper County tax bill?
sections.html:
Five bodies touch the bill, and the Tax Commissioner is only the last. The county commission and the school board choose millage, the assessors set value, a grand-jury-appointed board hears disputes, and the commissioner mails the bill and banks the payment.

  • Tax Commissioner: 126 W. Greene Street, Suite 125, Monticello, GA 31064; (706) 468-4902; weekdays, 8 a.m. until 4:30 p.m.
  • Tax Assessor: signs off on exemptions and mails a notice when it changes a value
  • Clerk of Superior Court: the deed room in the courthouse issues copies of warranty deeds

A mill is $1 for every $1,000 of assessed value, and assessed value is set at 40% of market value.

sections.h2: What due dates should Jasper County owners watch?
sections.html:
Real estate and business personal property are billed in two halves. The county's standing schedule lists September 20 and December 20.

The 2026 notice set a different first date. Bills were mailed October 16, the first installment was listed for November 20, and the balance for December 20. Because the opening date can move between years, rely on the dates printed on the bill in front of you.

  • Mobile and manufactured homes: tax and location permit by April 1
  • Missing that date costs a 10% penalty and can bring a Magistrate Court citation or a sale of the home
  • Cars and trucks follow the owner's birthday

sections.h2: What does a delinquent bill do to a Jasper County seller?
sections.html:
It can follow you to the closing table. Once taxes are more than 90 days late, a tax FiFa is recorded with the Clerk of Superior Court, and the county says unpaid property may be levied upon and sold.

FiFa entries are public, so credit bureaus can see them. The tax office says it cannot control what the bureaus do with the data. Plan to clear any recorded lien before closing.

Phone (706) 468-4902 for the exact balance. If the sale closes between the two installment dates, ask how each half should be handled and put the answer in the closing paperwork.

sections.h2: What homestead breaks are posted for Jasper County?
sections.html:
The standard exemption removes $2,000 from assessed value. It reduces the county, school and State levies but not the portion of the rate that repays bonds.

  • Age 62 and up, school tax: up to $10,000 off assessed value if income is $10,000 or less; bond levies included
  • Age 65 and up, general: up to $4,000 if applicant and spouse have net income of $10,000 or less, with Social Security and certain retirement income left out
  • Disabled veterans: up to $63,780, plus the same amount for an unremarried surviving spouse of a service member killed in armed conflict
  • Age 65 and up, State levy: the home and up to 10 acres can be fully exempt for owners who also qualify for another homestead exemption

Bring a driver's license with your Jasper County address to the Tax Commissioner. Applications have to land by April 1 for that tax year. Once approved, the exemption carries forward until you move, transfer title or switch exemption types. A local exemption larger than the State's takes its place.

sections.h2: How do I contest a Jasper County value?
sections.html:
File within 45 days of the notice date. You can ask the Board of Equalization or an arbitrator to hear it, and either decision can be taken on to Superior Court by written notice to the Board of Tax Assessors.

Owners can also plant a marker early. Between January 1 and April 1 you may file a return giving your own January 1 market value; if the assessors alter that value afterward, you have a firm basis to appeal. Mobile home owners get 45 days to file with the assessors and then 21 days from a change notice to reach the Board of Equalization.

sections.h2: What do returns and special programs involve in Jasper County?
sections.html:
All taxable property must be returned between January 1 and April 1. If you file nothing, the county treats the property as returned at last year's value with last year's real property exemptions.

Notices go to the last address you gave, so report a move to the Tax Assessor or the Tax Commissioner. A few programs change how land or buildings are valued.

  • Historic property: a register-listed building and up to two nearby acres may receive preferential assessment
  • Brownfield sites: approved cleanup property can have its value frozen for ten years
  • Firefighter and peace officer survivors: an unremarried surviving spouse of one killed on duty can receive a total exemption, supported by agency documents

If your land or building is enrolled in one of these, ask the Board of Tax Assessors what a new owner would need to do to keep the status.

faqs.q: What is the office address for Jasper County property tax payments?
faqs.a: 126 W. Greene Street, Suite 125, Monticello, GA 31064. Call (706) 468-4902; the office keeps weekday hours from 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

faqs.q: By when must a Jasper County homestead application arrive?
faqs.a: April 1 of the first year you claim it. A later application is applied to the following tax year, and you must have owned and lived in the home on January 1.

faqs.q: Does an unpaid Jasper County bill reach credit reports?
faqs.a: It can. After 90 days unpaid, a FiFa lien is recorded with the Clerk of Superior Court, and those records are public.

faqs.q: Where can I get a copy of my deed in Jasper County?
faqs.a: The deed room at the Clerk of Superior Court, inside the Jasper County Courthouse, can supply a copy of a warranty deed.

faqs.q: What is the Jasper County appeal period?
faqs.a: Forty-five days from the date printed on the assessment notice. After a ruling, a written notice to the Board of Tax Assessors continues the case in Superior Court.
